description: Phase 3C. Exercises the MASQUE sub-mode chooser cascade end-to-end. Day 1 enables the experimental-families gate so masque routes are selectable. Day 3 forces a fresh UDP probe outcome of OK on the active network (which biases chooseSubmode to masque_h3_quic). Day 7 simulates a network roam to a network where UDP is suppressed; the next session MUST pick masque_h2_connect at start because the per-network UDPProbeOK is false on the new network. Day 14 returns to the original network; the engine MUST resume masque_h3_quic per the persisted netmem hint. The legacy subscription-url block is layered so the distribution-failure invariants continue to assert.
